transcript: My friend, there is a powerful medicine that most people ignore every single day. It's not a herb, it's not a tea, and it costs you nothing. This medicine is gratitude. When your mind is stressed, it looks for everything that is missing, everything that is wrong, everything that is heavy. But when you practice gratitude, your mind returns to what is already here, already supporting you, already keeping you alive. Gratitude softens the heart, it calms the nervous system, it lowers the fire of stress inside your body, and it reminds you that even on difficult days, life is still giving you small blessings. So today, I want you to try something. Sit down, place your hand on your chest, take one slow breath, and ask yourself quietly, what helped me today? Maybe it was the sun warming your face, maybe it was the food that gave you strength, maybe it was one person or one small moment that held you together. Hold that memory for three breaths, feel that warmth in your chest. This is gratitude, this is medicine, this is how you return to balance. Practice this every night for seven days. You will feel lighter, you will sleep deeper, and your heart will feel new again. If you want more practices like this, the full 30-day healing journey is waiting for you in my profile.
